guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Use absolute paths to reference templates
guidelines.summary: Use absolute paths to reference stages, jobs, steps and variables templates.

detection.pattern: template:\s*(?!/)[^@\n]+\.ya?ml
detection.message: Template referenced with a relative path. Use an absolute, repo-rooted path starting with "/".

fix.summary: Reference templates with absolute paths rooted at the repository.
steps: Replace relative template paths (./ or ../) with an absolute path starting at "/".
Keep paths stable when files move between folders.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Use native YAML constructs when possible
guidelines.summary: Prefer YAML‑native constructs to express values, logic, and scripts in a clear, consistent, and platform‑agnostic way.

detection.pattern: Inline JSON-style YAML, string-encoded lists/maps, or scripts replacing native YAML constructs.
detection.message: Prefer native YAML constructs (lists, maps, multiline blocks) over string-encoded or scripted equivalents.

fix.summary: Rewrite values, logic, and scripts using native YAML constructs.
steps: Replace inline JSON-style YAML with native YAML lists and maps.
Use multiline block scalars for scripts instead of single-line strings.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Align template parameters with the YAML schema
guidelines.summary: When adding parameters that map to Azure Pipelines YAML fields, use the same name, type, and a schema-compatible default value so templates work naturally without requiring every parameter to be explicitly set.

detection.pattern: Template parameters that mirror Azure Pipelines fields but use different names/types or incompatible defaults.
detection.message: Align parameter name, type, and default with the matching Azure Pipelines YAML schema field.

fix.summary: Match parameter name, type, and default to the underlying YAML schema field.
steps: Rename parameters to match the schema field they map to.
Use a schema-compatible type and default value.

guidelines.title: DO: Document pipelines and templates
guidelines.summary: Document pipelines and templates. Add comments to the top of pipeline and template files. Describe the purpose, usage, and other relevant information clearly for both people and tools.

detection.pattern: Pipeline or template file with no header comment describing purpose and usage.
detection.message: Add a header comment describing the purpose, usage, and parameters of this pipeline or template.

fix.summary: Add a descriptive header comment to pipeline and template files.
steps: Add a comment block at the top describing purpose, usage, and parameters.

guidelines.title: DO: Use a consistent folder structure
guidelines.summary: Organize pipelines and templates logically and consistently across different projects and repositories.

detection.pattern: Templates scattered without a consistent /pipelines folder structure.
detection.message: Organize pipelines and templates using a consistent folder structure.

fix.summary: Adopt a consistent, predictable folder structure for pipelines and templates.
steps: Group templates by type (stages, jobs, steps, variables) under a shared root.

guidelines.title: DO: Use templates everywhere
guidelines.summary: Create and reference templates instead of defining logic or configuration directly in your pipelines or templates.

detection.pattern: Stages, jobs, or steps defined inline in a pipeline instead of referencing templates.
detection.message: Move repeated logic and configuration into templates and reference them.

fix.summary: Extract inline logic into templates and reference them.
steps: Identify repeated inline logic.
Extract it into a stages/jobs/steps template.
Reference the template from the pipeline.

guidelines.title: DO NOT: Hard-code values in pipelines and templates
guidelines.summary: Do not hard-code values in Azure DevOps pipelines and templates.

detection.pattern: Literal environment names, regions, URLs, resource names, or versions embedded directly in pipeline/template bodies.
detection.message: Replace hard-coded values with parameters or variables.

fix.summary: Move hard-coded values into parameters or variable templates.
steps: Replace literals with parameters or variables.
Source environment-specific values from variable templates.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Explicitly declare checkout in jobs
guidelines.summary: Explicitly set `checkout` in every job to make source code checkout behavior clear and stable.

detection.pattern: jobs[].steps where no checkout step is present
detection.message: Declare checkout explicitly (checkout: self or checkout: none) to make source checkout behavior clear.

fix.summary: Add an explicit checkout step to every job.
steps: Add "checkout: self" or "checkout: none" as the first step of the job.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Grouping job tasks into a single template
guidelines.summary: Group job tasks into a single steps template, rather than using multiple steps templates in a job.

detection.pattern: A single job referencing multiple separate steps templates that always run together.
detection.message: Group tasks that always run together into a single steps template.

fix.summary: Consolidate related steps templates into one.
steps: Combine the steps templates used together into a single template and reference it once.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Declaring variables at the job level
guidelines.summary: Declare variables at the job level instead of the stage or root level.

detection.pattern: Variables used by a single job declared at stage or root level.
detection.message: Declare job-specific variables at the job level to reduce scope.

fix.summary: Move single-job variables down to the job scope.
steps: Move variables only used by one job into that job's variables block.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Adding a validation flag to your job
guidelines.summary: Add a `boolean` parameter to your job to run it in _validation mode_, without deploying or executing any changes.

detection.pattern: Deployment/change job template without a boolean validation/what-if flag.
detection.message: Add a boolean parameter to run the job in validation mode without applying changes.

fix.summary: Add a boolean validation-mode parameter to the job.
steps: Add a boolean parameter (e.g. validateOnly).
Guard change-applying steps with a condition on that parameter.

guidelines.title: DO: Create configurable and extensible jobs
guidelines.summary: When creating job templates for reuse by different teams, stages, or pipelines, add parameters such as:

detection.pattern: Reusable job template that hard-codes pool, container, dependsOn, or condition instead of exposing parameters.
detection.message: Expose control settings (pool, dependsOn, condition, etc.) as parameters in reusable job templates.

fix.summary: Parameterize control settings in reusable job templates.
steps: Add parameters for pool, dependsOn, condition, and other reuse-relevant settings.

guidelines.title: DO: Set job timeouts
guidelines.summary: Set job timeouts or add parameters to shared job templates to let users configure them.

detection.pattern: jobs[] missing timeoutInMinutes
detection.message: Set timeoutInMinutes on the job, or expose it as a parameter in shared templates.

fix.summary: Set a job timeout or expose it as a parameter.
steps: Add timeoutInMinutes to the job.
In shared templates, add a timeout parameter with a sensible default.

guidelines.title: DO: Minimize the number of parameters in job templates
guidelines.summary: When defining job templates in Azure DevOps pipelines, keep the number of **environment-related** parameters as short as possible.

detection.pattern: Job template with many environment-related parameters that could come from variable templates.
detection.message: Minimize environment-related parameters; source environment values from variable templates instead.

fix.summary: Reduce environment-related parameters by sourcing values from variable templates.
steps: Move environment-specific parameters into variable templates referenced by the job.

guidelines.title: DO: Ensure jobs have a single responsibility
guidelines.summary: Focus each job on a single, well-defined responsibility.

detection.pattern: A job performing multiple unrelated responsibilities (e.g. build + deploy + test).
detection.message: Split jobs so each has a single, well-defined responsibility.

fix.summary: Split multi-purpose jobs into single-responsibility jobs.
steps: Separate unrelated responsibilities into distinct jobs.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Grouping related parameters
guidelines.summary: Group related parameters, such as username and password.

detection.pattern: Related parameters (e.g. username and password) declared separately without grouping.
detection.message: Group related parameters together (e.g. into an object parameter).

fix.summary: Group related parameters, for example using an object parameter.
steps: Combine related scalar parameters into a single object parameter.

guidelines.title: DO: Restrict parameter values
guidelines.summary: Restrict the values of parameters when they have a well-defined set.

detection.pattern: parameters[] with a finite value set but no "values:" list
detection.message: Restrict parameter values with a "values:" list when the set is well-defined.

fix.summary: Add a values list to constrain parameters with a known set.
steps: Add a "values:" allow-list to the parameter definition.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Running pipelines in validation mode
guidelines.summary: Add a parameter or condition to run the pipeline in _validation mode_, skipping deployment or changes.

detection.pattern: Pipeline that applies changes with no way to run in validation/what-if mode.
detection.message: Add a parameter or condition to run the pipeline in validation mode.

fix.summary: Add a validation-mode parameter or condition to the pipeline.
steps: Add a validation parameter.
Skip deployment/change steps when validation mode is on.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Grouping related jobs into stages
guidelines.summary: Organize related jobs into stages to:

detection.pattern: Many related jobs at pipeline root with no stage grouping.
detection.message: Group related jobs into stages for clearer structure and control.

fix.summary: Organize related jobs into stages.
steps: Wrap related jobs in a stage with a meaningful name.

guidelines.title: DO: Run stages in parallel when possible
guidelines.summary: Run independent stages in parallel.

detection.pattern: Independent stages chained with unnecessary dependsOn, forcing serial execution.
detection.message: Remove unnecessary dependsOn so independent stages run in parallel.

fix.summary: Let independent stages run in parallel by removing needless dependsOn.
steps: Remove dependsOn between stages that have no real dependency.

guidelines.title: AVOID: Using pipeline variables in tasks or steps templates
guidelines.summary: Avoid pipeline variables in steps templates. Use parameters instead.

detection.message: Steps template reads a pipeline variable with $(...). Pass values as parameters instead.

fix.summary: Replace pipeline variable reads in steps templates with template parameters.
steps: Add a parameter for each consumed value.
Replace $(var) references with ${{ parameters.x }}.
Pass values from the caller.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Setting environment variables at the task level
guidelines.summary: Set environment variables at the task level.

detection.pattern: Values a task needs set as pipeline-wide variables instead of in the task env block.
detection.message: Set environment variables at the task level via the env: block.

fix.summary: Scope environment variables to the task using its env block.
steps: Move values into the task-level env: block.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Logging diagnostic details
guidelines.summary: Log enough diagnostic details required to troubleshoot issues and failures.

detection.pattern: Scripts/tasks that fail without logging enough diagnostic context.
detection.message: Log enough diagnostic detail to troubleshoot failures.

fix.summary: Add diagnostic logging to steps to aid troubleshooting.
steps: Log key inputs, versions, and state needed to diagnose failures.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Logging diagnostic details
guidelines.summary: Log enough diagnostic details required to troubleshoot issues and failures.

detection.pattern: Scripts/tasks that fail without logging enough diagnostic context.
detection.message: Log enough diagnostic detail to troubleshoot failures.

fix.summary: Add diagnostic logging to steps to aid troubleshooting.
steps: Log key inputs, versions, and state needed to diagnose failures.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Configuring retries in tasks
guidelines.summary: Configure the number of retries if a task faces transient failures.

detection.pattern: Installer or package-manager tasks (NuGet, npm, downloads) without retryCountOnTaskFailure.
detection.message: Configure retryCountOnTaskFailure for tasks prone to transient failures.

fix.summary: Add retryCountOnTaskFailure to transient-failure-prone tasks.
steps: Add retryCountOnTaskFailure to installer/network tasks.
Do not retry build, test, or deployment tasks.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Set task timeouts
guidelines.summary: Set timeouts for tasks to avoid stalling pipeline runs. Provide reasonable values based on the expected execution time.

detection.pattern: steps[].task missing timeoutInMinutes
detection.message: Set timeoutInMinutes on tasks to avoid stalling pipeline runs.

fix.summary: Set a reasonable timeout on long-running tasks.
steps: Add timeoutInMinutes based on expected execution time.

guidelines.title: DO: Create configurable and extensible steps
guidelines.summary: When building reusable templates, add these control parameters:

detection.pattern: Reusable steps template without control parameters (condition, enabled, name overrides).
detection.message: Add control parameters to make steps templates configurable.

fix.summary: Add control parameters to reusable steps templates.
steps: Expose condition, enable/disable, and naming as parameters.

guidelines.title: DO: Use service connections when possible
guidelines.summary: Use Service Connections to authenticate with external services (Azure, GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, etc.).

detection.pattern: Tasks authenticating with inline credentials/keys instead of a service connection.
detection.message: Authenticate to external services with a service connection, not inline credentials.

fix.summary: Replace inline credentials with a service connection.
steps: Create a service connection for the external service.
Reference it from the task instead of passing credentials.

guidelines.title: DO: Validate step parameters
guidelines.summary: Validate step parameters in templates. Fail the pipeline if a parameter is invalid.

detection.pattern: Steps template using parameters without validating them or failing fast on invalid input.
detection.message: Validate step parameters and fail the pipeline on invalid input.

fix.summary: Validate parameters in steps templates and fail fast.
steps: Add validation logic that fails the pipeline when a parameter is invalid.

guidelines.title: DO NOT: Mix pipelines syntax in script tasks
guidelines.summary: Do not embed pipeline expressions (`$(...)` or `${{ ... }}`) throughout the body of a script task. Bind them at the boundary instead — either in the task-level `env:` block or as variable assignments at the very top of the script.

detection.message: Pipeline expression used inside a script body. Bind it via the env: block or at the top of the script instead.

fix.summary: Bind pipeline expressions at the boundary (env block) instead of inside script bodies.
steps: Move $(...) and ${{ }} out of the script body.
Pass them through the task env: block and read them as environment variables.

guidelines.title: DO NOT: Use AzureKeyVault task
guidelines.summary: Do not run the `AzureKeyVault` task to pull secrets into pipeline variables.

detection.pattern: task:\s*AzureKeyVault@\d+
detection.message: AzureKeyVault task pulls secrets into pipeline variables. Use a variable group linked to Key Vault instead.

fix.summary: Replace the AzureKeyVault task with a Key Vault-linked variable group and explicit parameters.
steps: Link the Key Vault to a variable group.
Reference the group from a variables template.
Pass only the required secrets as explicit step parameters.

guidelines.title: CONSIDER: Declaring variables as read-only
guidelines.summary: Mark variables as `readonly` when they shouldn't change after you initialize them.

detection.pattern: Constant variables that should not change after initialization declared without readonly.
detection.message: Mark variables readonly when they should not change after initialization.

fix.summary: Declare unchanging variables as readonly.
steps: Add readonly: true to variables that must not be reassigned.

guidelines.title: DO: Organize variables by component and environment
guidelines.summary: Organize your variables into folders by functionality, environment, or any logical partition that fits your project.

detection.pattern: Variable templates not organized by component/environment.
detection.message: Organize variables into folders by component and environment.

fix.summary: Organize variable templates by component and environment.
steps: Split variables into folders by component, environment, or logical partition.

guidelines.title: DO: Store sensitive information in variable groups
guidelines.summary: Store passwords, tokens, and keys inside [variable groups](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/devops/pipelines/library/variable-groups?view=azure-devops&tabs=yaml).

detection.pattern: (?i)(password|secret|token|api[_-]?key|client[_-]?secret)\s*:\s*['"]?\S+
detection.message: Possible secret stored as a plaintext variable. Store secrets in a variable group instead.

fix.summary: Move secrets into variable groups instead of plaintext variables.
steps: Move passwords, tokens, and keys into a variable group.
Reference the group from the pipeline.

guidelines.title: DO: Separate configuration from logic
guidelines.summary: Avoid hard-coding configuration values inside pipeline, step, job, or stage templates.

detection.pattern: Configuration values hard-coded inside pipeline/job/stage/step templates.
detection.message: Separate configuration from logic by sourcing values from variable templates.

fix.summary: Move configuration out of logic templates into variable templates.
steps: Extract configuration values into variable templates and reference them.

guidelines.title: DO: Reduce variable scope
guidelines.summary: Restrict the scope of variables as much as possible.

detection.pattern: Variables declared at root/stage level but used only in a narrower scope.
detection.message: Restrict variable scope to the narrowest level where it is used.

fix.summary: Declare variables at the narrowest scope that needs them.
steps: Move variables down to the job or step scope where they are actually used.

guidelines.title: DO NOT: Mix variables from different environments
guidelines.summary: Do not define variables for multiple environments inside a single variable template.

detection.pattern: A single variable template defining values for multiple environments (dev/test/prod).
detection.message: Split per-environment values into separate variable templates.

fix.summary: Use one variable template per environment.
steps: Split mixed-environment variables into per-environment templates.
